## Capability map

The API paths below were checked against operations.json. Core support does not imply UI integration. Locate each capability in real implementation; leave unimplemented positions empty instead of filling them with prototype records.

| Capability | Core API / source | UI baseline / owner |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Conversation / draft / outbox / anchor | `GET /api/v1/timeline`, `POST /api/v1/messages`; `Connected.svelte`, `storage.rs` | FE-02 minimal; #63 full page |
| Tasks / executions / authorization | `GET /api/v1/tasks`, `GET /api/v1/executions/{id}`, `POST /api/v1/authorizations/{id}/decision`; `Work.svelte` | FE-02 minimal; #64 full page |
| Result / artifact save | `GET /api/v1/artifacts/{id}`, `GET /api/v1/artifacts/{id}/content`; `Results.svelte` | FE-02 minimal; #66 full library |
| Scope / decisions | `GET /api/v1/scopes`, `POST /api/v1/decisions/{id}/answer` | Core supported; full UI #64 |
| Memory / World | `GET /api/v1/memory/summary`, `GET /api/v1/memory/commitments`, `GET /api/v1/world/facts` | Core supported; UI #65 |
| Settings | `GET /api/v1/settings`, `POST /api/v1/settings/draft`, `POST /api/v1/settings/apply` | Core supported; UI #65 |
| Notifications | `GET /api/v1/notifications`, `POST /api/v1/notifications/{id}/presented`, `POST /api/v1/notifications/{id}/read` | Core supported; UI / OS presentation #66 |
| Devices / Portable / EVENT / remote tools | #6 / #11–#14 | FROZEN; empty placeholders |
| Motion gallery / example tasks / concept images | Static v1.0 only | Visual reference, no business capability |

## R1 decisions and retained clauses

Master confirmed v1.0 as sole visual authority, `Secretary` for blank names, Cmd+Enter to send/Enter for newline, domain-specific drafts/reading continuity, empty unimplemented features and v1.0 status colors. Added flexible center/fixed sidebars, joined selected surfaces, edge-aligned rules, complete three-frame coverage and random separator triggering. Sidebar text/existing inter-button lines and performance comparison are #62 experiments. These explicit decisions override example behavior such as fixed PERRI, local Enter sending and playback on every approach.

Valid v0.3 requirements are now framework-independent: drafts/reading position and persistence before clearing, stable request_id with receipts/unknown outcomes, entity-ID relationships/navigation, notification presented/read and historical watermark; see architecture and flows. SwiftUI, Xcode, fixed pt/palette and VoiceOver-only acceptance are retired requirements. VoiceOver remains useful on macOS, with behavior as the acceptance criterion.
